cues.text: A bright sun flares from behind the horizon of a massive gas giant, illuminating a hazy nebula.
The planet's atmosphere is a swirling canvas of caramel, rust, and cream.
A colony ship streaks across the turbulent bands, a single spark trailing a line of white light as it descends toward the brilliant glare.

beats.note: A massive gas giant planet fills the right side of the screen, with a sun flaring from behind its left horizon.
A colony ship appears as a bright streak of light on the right side of the planet.
The ship continues to move left across the swirling bands of brown and orange gas.
The ship nears the flaring sun on the horizon.
